title: 2D Product Photography
description: Automated 2D product photo studios by PackshotCreator: adjustable LED lighting, white background without cutout, Hyperfocus and integrated control software.
content:
PackshotCreator offers a wide range of professional photo studios and equipment dedicated to 2D product photography. These advanced technologies are paired with unique software that controls the camera and lighting settings to speed up visual production. Automatically take product photos on a pure white or transparent background for ecommerce or many other uses, all without any knowledge required in photography.

Let your products do the selling for you

PLACE, OBSERVE, CREATE AND PUBLISH

  • Create your product photographs in-house
  • Automate and simplify the entire photography process
  • Adjust the camera and lighting settings directly through the software
  • Preview the result even before taking the photo with the LiveView
  • Take photos of your products from multiple angles with different cameras
  • Easily take photos of your products on a pure white background
  • Instantly cut out all your products on a transparent background
  • Create composites of your products on custom backgrounds
  • Eliminate retouching steps and save considerable time
  • Produce consistent series of product photos
  • Save all the settings and reuse them over time to increase your productivity
  • Save multiple images in multiple formats instantly

VERSATILE PHOTO STUDIOS FOR ALL TYPES OF USES

PackshotCreator offers a complete range of automated product photography solutions, specially designed to meet the needs of every industry. From the wireless LED lighting kit, to compact and versatile desktop photo studios, through to flat lay photography systems dedicated to clothing and fashion accessories.

All the photo studios are paired with the powerful and productive PackshotCreator software, which automates the entire creation process.

PackshotCreator photo studios with variable-intensity LED lighting

All PackshotCreator photo studios feature professional and efficient LED lighting. All the light sources in the photo studios can be adjusted individually from 1 to 100%. Once the lighting is validated, the configured settings can be saved and reused for other products of the same type. With a color temperature equivalent to daylight (5700°K), the LED crystals, designed to last more than 50,000 hours, make it easy to photograph products on a pure white background.Compact and fully sealed, all the systems are designed with side and front doors to prevent unwanted external light pollution. They therefore guarantee consistent and uniform results for 2D product photography.

LiveStudio - LED studio lighting and product photography software

LiveStudio is more than just lighting. This modern studio is made up of three technologies: 100% LED lighting, a control box and shooting software. The advanced software controls the connected camera and all the LiveStudio light sources in real time to automate, simplify and speed up every aspect of studio photography. Flexible and plug-and-play, the LiveStudio is the most accessible shooting solution on the market.

Flat Lay Flat-lay fashion photography

The unique design of the LuminaPad Mark II simplifies flat-lay shooting of clothing and accessories. Thanks to the professional LED lighting adjustable along the entire length of the table and on the four side panels, it is very easy to get product photos on white and transparent backgrounds with an ultra-precise and uniform color representation.

Enjoy an optional second shooting mode: turn the table vertically and transform it into a backlit background where fashion items and accessories can be photographed on mannequins or live models.

A global success across all sectors

For nearly 20 years, we have pursued a single goal: to offer our customers, creators and designers, start-ups and large companies, the best of innovation, so that they can take superb photos of their products, effortlessly. Our automated studios have already won over more than 20,000 users in 35 countries.

The best systems

We are the world leader in still product photography, in360° solutions and 3D. Our studios and equipment are designed with a focus on simplicity, productivity and creativity. Designed and redesigned to be flexible and durable, our systems guarantee constant and consistent lighting, precise control and high-quality visuals.

With more than 70 patents, we constantly improve and innovate our current range of products and services, while launching new systems to meet the needs and demands of our customers and the market.

The best software for product photography

The PackshotCreator software is the most powerful and most unique product photography software on the market. It works perfectly with our systems to automate, simplify and speed up the image creation process, while delivering high-quality professional images.

All the settings, from the camera, the lighting and the positioning, are savable and reusable infinitely for greater productivity and consistency. The results can be seen even before the photo is taken and the visuals can be exported in multiple formats simultaneously.

You can easily photograph products on a pure white background or cut them out automatically. Take photos of two or more products together and automatically get individual files for each fully cut-out product. With our software, the possibilities are endless!

Discover the software's strengths

Consistent product placement

Strengthen the consistency of your series of product visuals while saving time and money. With the Ghost Image feature of the PackshotCreator software, place your products consistently at every shoot: the ghost image memorizes the position of an object previously placed in the studio and creates a semi-transparent (ghost) image. Thanks to the live preview, it can serve as a guide to place the next product in exactly the same spot. The ghost image works not only for photos, but also for animations and 360° videos and 3D views. These semi-transparent images can be saved and reused over time.
